notes: The breadboard is drawn rotated: each horizontal row of 5 holes is one strip. Mapped to strips 1t, 2t, 3t (wire in hole a, TMP36 leg in hole e).

Red wire goes to the 5V header pin (next to 3.3V), black to the first GND pin, yellow to A1. The text says A0/A2 can power the sensor, but the circuit image and schematic show 5V/GND. The schematic labels the signal as A0, but the Fritzing image and text use A1, so A1 is used.
TMP36 legs, top to bottom in the image: +Vs, Vout, GND (matches schematic pins 1, 2, 3).
The SD card / USB stick goes into the Yún's slot; it has no electrical edges and no specific port is named.

The E2 warnings (ICSP.VCC tied to 5V, ICSP.GND tied to GND) are not real problems and the graph is unchanged. The Yún catalogue entry already connects the ICSP header's VCC and GND pins to the board's 5V and GND nets. The manual has no wire or part on the ICSP header, and the graph has no edge to ICSP.VCC or ICSP.GND. The checker is reporting the board's own internal wiring, which I'm not allowed to edit.
